item.title: Osaka Spring Grand Sumo Tournament: The Haru Basho — Guide
item.description: The Spring Grand Sumo Tournament, the Haru Basho, is one of only six professional sumo tournaments held each year, and its March run makes Osaka one of the best places outside Tokyo to see the sport live. Over fifteen days at the Edion Arena (Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium) in Namba, wrestlers fight daily to build a winning record, the action climbing from lower divisions in the quiet morning to the top-division makuuchi bouts, ring-entering ceremonies and title race in the charged late afternoon.

item.title: Japan in March 2026: Cherry Blossoms & Weather Guide
item.description: Japan in March: Cherry Blossoms, Weather, What to Expect — The Complete Insider Guide for 2025 March is when Japan shakes off winter and begins its most celebrated transformation. If you’re planning to visit Japan in March, cherry blossoms, weather, and what to expect are probably dominating your research — and for good reason. This is the month when the country transitions from quiet, crisp winter days into the explosive beauty of early spring.

item.title: Japan in March 2026: Cherry Blossoms & Weather Guide
item.description: Japan in March: What to Do, Cherry Blossoms, Weather & the Complete Insider Guide for 2025 March is when Japan shakes off winter and begins its most poetic transformation. If you’re researching Japan in March — what to do, cherry blossoms, weather — you’ve chosen one of the most rewarding months to visit. The country straddles two worlds: the tail end of winter lingers in the north while the south erupts in plum blossoms, early cherry blossoms, and the first warm breezes of spring.
